comment: Inputs of the R1-BX-D14 recompute (g4_lib.py dates). Before G.4 runs, llm_seconds_fallback and executed_share_fallback stand in for the pilot medians; every other value is an assumption to be confirmed (slots, queue, prerequisite and analysis spans; prerequisite_days covers running and reading G.4, the G.5 signature and the K check). The B7->D3->manuscript spans are the R1-BX-D14 target spans (8 Dec -> 3 Jan -> 10 Jan).
